name: Transfer Teacher
source:
Into the snowy season, into the uneventful life of Lee comes she, the exchange professor from J-Country. Not only beautiful, but also passionate... about teaching. 

[From [url=http://renai.us/game/transfer.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
积雪覆盖大地的季节里，一名来自J国的交换教授走进了李平淡无奇的生活。她不仅美丽动人，还对教学充满热情…

[摘自[url=http://renai.us/game/transfer.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
